name: Caiaphas
overview: Caiaphas, the high priest and son-in-law of Annas, plays a pivotal role in the events leading to the crucifixion of Jesus. Scripture records that he convened the chief priests, scribes, and elders to plot against Jesus, who was brought before him for trial. During this trial, Caiaphas directly questioned Jesus about His identity as the Christ, the Son of God, and reacted strongly to Jesus’ affirmation by accusing Him of blasphemy. Caiaphas also presided over the accusations against Peter and other disciples, underscoring his central position in the opposition to Christ’s ministry.
